names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 mai, «Sfântul Shio din Mgvime, Georgia». The life of John of Zedazeni, linked from the 7 mai line, prints the same form in its list of the thirteen Syrian fathers and calls him afterwards Sisoe.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιοι Ευάγριος και Σίος εκ Γεωργίας», with the rank word left off.
Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 6 февраля ст. ст., «Преподобный Шио Мгвимский», with the rank word and the office left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's naming clause in the entry headed „Преподобни оци грузијски.“ for 7. мај ст. ст. — „А имена су њихова: Авид, Антоније, Давид, Зинон, Тадеј, Иса, Издериос, Јосиф, Михаил, Пир, Стефан и Шијо.“ The list carries no rank word and no epithet on any of the twelve; Преподобни heads the whole company in the heading and belongs to no one name, and the see or monastery each folder's English name keeps is nowhere on this page. So the bare forename is the whole of the form. The form meets no other folder in any language, which was measured rather than assumed.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 февраля ст. ст. — «Прп. Шио Мгвимского (VI).»

feast.note: doxologia.ro prints him twice: alone on 9 mai, «Sfântul Shio din Mgvime, Georgia», with his own life, which says his memory is kept on 9 mai, the day of his repose, and on the Thursday of Cheesefare week; and on 7 mai among the twelve disciples of John of Zedazeni, where the thirteen Syrian fathers are kept together. The 9 mai day, which is his own and which his own page gives, is the one recorded; the 7 mai company is recorded here and not as a second row.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 mai — «Sfântul Shio din Mgvime, Georgia»

feast.note: The life page saint.gr gives for this line carries no life at all, only «Βλέπε 4 Ιανουαρίου» — see 4 January — so the Greek calendar appears to keep the pair on that day as well (https://www.saint.gr/1281/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026); the 4 January Greek day page was not read. The corpus's Romanian row keeps him on 9 May, the day of his repose, and that row already carries its own second-day note.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιοι Ευάγριος και Σίος εκ Γεωργίας»
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 20.05.2026 (7. мај ст. ст.) — „Преподобни оци грузијски.“

attestations.note: **The heading names nobody and the body enumerates the whole company, so the citation above is the heading whole** — „Преподобни оци грузијски.“ — per BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §4's synaxis ruling and the coordinator's first ruling for an enumerated company, and the Serbian name form is read out of the body's naming clause: „А имена су њихова: Авид, Антоније, Давид, Зинон, Тадеј, Иса, Издериос, Јосиф, Михаил, Пир, Стефан и Шијо.“ — twelve bare forenames, no rank word on any of them and no epithet, with Началник свих ових ... био је свети Јован Зедазнијски standing before the list for their leader. **The identification is the set and not the name**: the corpus already keeps these thirteen men together on this very menologion day, out of doxologia's «Sfântul Cuvios Ioan Zedazneli, dimpreună cu 12 ucenici din Georgia» and saint.gr's «Όσιος Ιωάννης και οι μαθητές αυτού», and the Prologue's twelve names map one-to-one onto the twelve folders, eleven of them unmistakably — Антоније, Давид, Зинон, Тадеј, Јосиф, Михаил, Пир, Стефан, Шијо, Иса for Ise of Tsilkani and Издериос for Isidore of Samtavisi — which forces the twelfth, Авид for Abibus of Nekresi, because it is the only slot and the only name left. **`types` was deliberately not touched on any of the thirteen.** Преподобни in that heading heads a company of thirteen whose own folders carry ranks three other calendars gave them — `hieromartyr` and `bishop` for Abibus, `hierarch` and `bishop` for Jesse, `stylite` for Anthony — and a rank word covering a whole company is not evidence about one man's own grade; adding it could make `honorific.js` compose a different word to every reader, which is the `boris-michael-of-bulgaria` ruling. **No `locations` were taken**: Georgia is a country. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. **NO DATE WAS TOUCHED**: this folder already holds a date from another calendar, and a century covering the whole mission would not sharpen it; the entry's „У VI веку“ is recorded in the appended paragraph and nothing was written into `dates`. **The day list could not see this folder and the entry's own naming clause is what caught him.** `sr-cand.mjs`'s list of what the corpus keeps on the menologion 7/5 names twenty-five folders and he is **not** among them, because his Romanian row is his own 9 mai, his Russian row the Julian 6 февруара and his Greek row 4 Φεβρουαρίου — three calendars, three days, none of them this one. His Romanian row already carries a note saying doxologia prints him twice, alone on 9 mai and on 7 mai among the twelve. `ls saints | grep -iE 'shio|mgvime'` and `john-of-zedazeni`'s own twelve-slug `related` list both found him at once. **That is the fifth day in seven on which the day list missed a folder the greps caught.**

birth.note: doxologia.ro, Viața Sfântului Shio din Mgvime, Georgia: «S-a născut în Siria, la Antiohia, la începutul secolului al VI-lea, din părinți nobili și bogați». The page gives no year for his death, only the day, 9 mai.

hymns.text: В тебе, отче, известно спасеся еже по образу,/ приим бо крест, последовал еси Христу,/ и, дея, учил еси презирати убо плоть, преходит бо,/ прилежати же о души, вещи безсмертней./ Темже и со Ангелы срадуется, преподобне Шио, дух твой.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 февраля ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобного Шио Мгвимского»

english.text: In thee, O father, that which was made after the image was surely kept safe; for taking up the cross thou didst follow Christ, and by thy doing thou didst teach men to despise the flesh, since it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore thy spirit, O venerable Shio, rejoices together with the angels.

hymns.text: Житие твое служением Господним исправил еси/ и, взем крест, оставил еси вся житейская,/ красото пустыни, преподобне Шио./ Кого убо паче тя, и по смерти жива суща/ страна Иверская почитает/ и мощми твоими, от гроба явленными услаждается,/ темже не престай моляся о нас ко Господу.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 февраля ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Шио Мгвимского»

english.text: Thou didst set thy life straight by the service of the Lord, and taking up the cross thou didst leave behind all the things of this life, O beauty of the wilderness, venerable Shio. Whom does the land of Iberia honour above thee, who art alive after death, and in whose relics, shown forth from the tomb, it takes its delight? Therefore cease not to pray to the Lord for us.
